name: window-edges
title: Window Edges
description: Move the focused window to a display edge without resizing
author: ammonkc

commands.name: move-left
commands.title: Move Window to Left Edge
commands.description: Move to the usable left screen edge, preserving size and the other axis

commands.name: move-right
commands.title: Move Window to Right Edge
commands.description: Move to the usable right screen edge, preserving size and the other axis

commands.name: move-top
commands.title: Move Window to Top Edge
commands.description: Move to the usable top screen edge, preserving size and the other axis

commands.name: move-bottom
commands.title: Move Window to Bottom Edge
commands.description: Move to the usable bottom screen edge, preserving size and the other axis

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p assets && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macosx13.0 native/WindowEdges.swift -o assets/window-edges
scripts.build: npm run build:native && ray build -e dist -o build --non-interactive
